launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95052&key=user_uploads/2656097/b9c1fd17-80cf-4a84-b400-34fc2577f0db)

Hey YC! We’re Cole and Eliot, and we’re building **Locus,** which is payment infrastructure for AI agents. We help developers safely connect agents to funds and define exactly how those funds can be used, with agent identities, budgets, permissions, and full audit trails.

# Our Story

We came to this problem from opposite ends of the same frontier. Cole spent last summer at Coinbase, building B2B payment products and seeing firsthand how control and compliance shape financial infrastructure. Eliot was working at Scale AI, maintaining data pipelines for the world’s largest AI labs. He watched as models began to tackle sustained, open-ended tasks. Both of us realized that as agents grow more capable, the next bottleneck isn’t intelligence: it’s _trust_.

Payments are a web primitive. And as we task agents with increasingly long and noisy workflows, they will _inevitably_ need to make payments. This might mean ordering parts to complete a physical repair, paying another agent for design work, hiring a contractor for a one-off task, or making micropayments to access private data.

But today’s payment rails were built for humans, not autonomous systems. There’s no safe way to say, “this agent can spend $500/day on these vendors,” and have that rule enforced. No audit trail showing which agent authorized what and why.

# Make Them Pay — Today!

Recently, OpenAI, Google, Visa, and Coinbase all released their own agentic payment protocols. But while everyone’s racing to build the next payment rails, nobody’s building the _control_ layer: the foundation that actually gives you power over how your agents use these rails. **Locus is building exactly this.**

Locus currently supports USDC on Base, with support for ACH and wire transfers coming soon. You can give your agents spending power and start building today.

# Demo

We built a micro-task payment system where an agent evaluates work submissions, scores quality, and pays contributors automatically. You set rules like "max $50 per payout, $500/day, must include a justification." The agent handles the rest. No manual approval needed, but you have full audit trails showing who got paid, when, and why.\
https://youtu.be/ICSzoZTq9JE

# Join Us!

If you build agents, join our beta and help shape the future of agent-driven finance! Learn more and sign up at [paywithlocus.com](http://paywithlocus.com). We'll give you $10 in USDC to experiment with.

We’re also building a community of builders in the space and would love for you to join. If agents with spending power sound at all interesting to you, join here to stay in the loop: https://discord.gg/TGnjUceXwE

launches.title: Caddy: The Voice Interface for Your Computer
launches.tagline: Changing how people work across their computer and apps with voice
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Connor](https://www.linkedin.com/in/connor-waslo/) and [Rajiv](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rajivsancheti/).

We led Loom’s AI suite and saw firsthand how natural language was changing how people work. Now we’re building Caddy, the voice interface for your computer that lets you automate work across all your apps.

Join the waitlist at [trycaddy.ai](http://trycaddy.ai)

**Launch video:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v1HwM9mBYHU

### **The problem**

Work today happens across a maze of apps. Slack for messaging. Linear for tickets. Gmail for communication. Calendar for scheduling. Every task requires jumping between tabs and tools.

Even with AI everywhere, we are still using the same old interfaces. Voice assistants like Siri or Alexa can answer trivia but cannot do real work. They do not understand what is on your screen, what app you are in, or what you mean when you say “follow up on this.”

The result is constant context switching, lost flow, and hours wasted on work that should happen automatically.

### **What we are building**

Caddy lives on your desktop and lets you operate your computer with your voice. It has two simple modes.

**Action mode:** You speak your intent, and Caddy takes action.

Ask Caddy to create a ticket in Linear, send a message in Slack, or schedule a meeting in Calendar. Caddy sees what is on your screen and connects it to your apps, so you can stay focused on the work that matters.

**Dictation mode:** Never type again

Write emails, respond to messages, or leave comments anywhere text input exists. It is a direct replacement for typing that works globally across your computer.

Together, these two modes let you automate work and control your computer completely with your voice.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95249&key=user_uploads/2945950/d99dbe1c-8793-4405-a7ca-568f05c831fd)

### **Who Caddy is for**

We are starting with founders, operators, productivity power users and the voice first generation who spend their days moving between tools and losing time to repetitive work. If that sounds like you, we would love to get you early access.

To join our waitlist add your email at [trycaddy.ai](http://trycaddy.ai) or shoot us a message [founders@trycaddy.ai](mailto:founders@trycaddy.ai)

### **The team**

Before starting Caddy, [Connor](https://www.linkedin.com/in/connor-waslo/) and [Rajiv](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rajivsancheti/) spent four years at Loom where they led product and design for Loom’s AI suite and core product.

name: The Context Company
long_description:
We analyze every conversation between your customers and your AI agent to find what's losing you customers and money. Then we help ship the fix and prove it worked.

Nobody on the team can read every conversation once an agent is in production. TCC does, and turns them into patterns tied to the accounts they affect: where customers get stuck, what they wish the agent could do, and where it's spending more than it needs to.

Engineers ask about a pattern from their IDE through our MCP, get the conversations and traces behind it down to the tool call or prompt that went wrong, ship the fix, and benchmark cost and quality before and after. Product sees what customers are actually trying to do with the agent and where it falls short, broken out by topic and account, which becomes the backlog for what to build next. Customer success sees which accounts the agent is struggling with before the customer says anything, and steps in with the full conversation on hand.

Any agent framework, a few lines of code. If you're running an agent in production or about to launch, ping us.
one_liner: Find what's losing you customers and money in your AI agent and fix it

launches.title: The Context Company - Catch Silent AI Failures Before They Break Production
launches.tagline: Full observability for AI agents, from bad tool calls, loops, and hallucinations to latency and cost, in 10 lines of code.
launches.body:
What is up! We’re [Arman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/armankumaraswamy/) and [Rohil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rohil-ag/) - cofounders of [The Context Company](https://thecontextcompany.com)

**TL;DR**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/129e5656-94c6-42e6-a2ba-6ac545b0ef94)

Setup takes under 10 lines of code, and we now support Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, and LangGraph, with more frameworks coming fast.

**Our Ask**

* If you’re building with Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, or LangGraph, use The Context Company for observability.
* Setup takes just a few lines - DM us on Bookface or Slack, or email [founders@thecontextcompany.com](https://mailto:founders@thecontextcompany.com), and we’ll personally onboard you in 15 minutes.
* Not using those frameworks yet? Tell us what you’re building with, and we’ll add support fast.

<https://youtu.be/5FVesVO9egg>

**The Problem**

AI agents often fail quietly. Traditional observability tools only show latency or stack traces. They miss the silent layer of failures that happen inside reasoning steps or tool calls.

Most teams end up waiting until users report issues, and by then, it’s already too late. As a developer, I know you’ve been there scrolling through endless logs, trying to piece together what an agent actually did and why it failed (because trust us, we have too 🙏🏽).

**We’re rethinking observability from the ground up and making silent failures a first-class primitive in agent monitoring.**

\*\*Our Solution:\*\*\
Instead of just visualizing traces, we analyze them and detect reasoning breakdowns across runs. In addition to traditional metrics like latency, cost, and token usage, The Context Company surfaces failures in a clean, developer-friendly dashboard.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/861e36d0-5a8b-4555-a738-e2489729f99f)

And we’ve gone beyond the cloud:

You can now run our developer package locally to debug traces on your machine, even when you’re offline or iterating fast.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/b7722f3f-a018-4c46-806c-7ef4be35bd44)

**Our Progress**

* Framework support: Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, and LangGraph.
* Instant setup: <10 lines of code - no refactoring or modifying your agent needed. This is what it looks like:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94947&key=user_uploads/2579624/560baa96-5818-4d20-bf82-43f2d3775ca3)

* Local debugging: Run observability locally on your laptop for real-time trace analysis.
* Dashboards: Full visibility into agent runs, tool calls, latency, costs, and semantic failures.

Arman and Rohil have been best friends since 6th grade (8+ years now!). 

Arman optimized the public-facing AI agent at Mintlify, where he cut failure rates by 82%, and worked with enterprise design partners to build custom agents. Rohil worked on Gmail Intelligence at Google, reducing hallucinations in intent detection by 27% across 26B+ daily emails.

launches.tagline: Get a versioned, stateful API for your long-running agent in 5 minutes
launches.body:
Point our CLI at your agent project, run `dari deploy`and get a production-ready agent API.

<https://youtu.be/Y6CdktXcF24>

## What it is

[dari.dev](http://dari.dev) turns an agent project into a **versioned, stateful API endpoint**. We’re building on top of the best open-source harnesses starting with **Pi**. Support coming soon for **Hermes** Agent. Book a call to deploy your proprietary harness.

### How it works:

* Drop a dari.yml + tools + skills at your repo root
* “dari deploy .” uploads a snapshot and publishes a new version behind a stable agent URL
* Clients open a **durable session** and stream multimodal events (text, files, images)
* The platform runs the harness, spins up a sandbox workspace per session, and handles logs, retries, and credentials
* New publishes create new versions. In-flight sessions stay pinned to the version they started on

## The problem:

If you're building an agent right now, you're probably:

* Stitching together durable execution + a sandbox provider + Postgres + a secret store yourself
* Losing state when a turn crashes mid-execution
* Shipping “agents” that can’t survive a 30-minute task
* Rebuilding the same infra (auth, retries, workspace, logs) on every project

Most agents break mid-task.

## With [dari.dev](http://dari.dev):

* **Durable sessions:** Long-running tasks survive crashes, restarts, and redeploys. Resume from the same session_id days/months/years later.
* **Versioned deploys:** Every publish is a new version behind one stable URL. Roll forward without breaking live sessions.
* **Bring your own sandbox:** Sandboxes run under your provider account and API key. You control limits and data. E2B today, Daytona / Blaxel / Modal coming soon.
* **BYOK with OpenRouter / any OpenAI-compatible API endpoint:** Use your own key, pick your model, control spend, keep logs.
* **Custom tools**: Drop Python or TypeScript tools under tools/<name>/. We run them with retry policies you define.

**The API:**

Publish once. Then, create a session and send messages + stream responses.

We provide full observability, session-level event logs, per-turn state, and workspace file outputs attached to the session lifecycle.

## Why we built this

We started building browser automation agents and kept hitting the same missing primitive, a durable control plane underneath.

We built it for ourselves, then realized every other team shipping agents (coding, research, ops) is rebuilding the same layer.

If you’ve wired together durable execution + a sandbox provider + Postgres + a secret store just to run one agent in prod, this is for you.

## Get access

* App: [app.dari.dev](http://app.dari.dev), docs: [docs.dari.dev](http://docs.dari.dev)
* Install the CLI, run `dari auth login`then publish from your repo
* Pricing: Either you pay your providers directly (E2B + OpenRouter/OpenAI) or use our managed Anthropic/OpenAI/OpenRouter offerings. No markup from us initially.

Book a call: calendly.com/avyay-dari/30min or email me at [avyay@dari.dev](mailto:avyay@dari.dev).

launches.body:
Hey everyone,

We’re [Ben](https://www.linkedin.com/in/benjaminyhong/) and [Avyay](https://www.linkedin.com/in/avyayv/), the cofounders of [Dari](https://www.usedari.com)!

**Tl;dr**

https://youtu.be/qE8wWHLhcv0

We've built the first browser automation platform reliable enough for production. While other agents fail on repetitive tasks, Dari caches successful workflows and handles 2FA automatically, making browser automation actually work for real businesses.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94481&key=user_uploads/870512/3189ec11-b583-4b3e-94a8-a489ace5f2a0)

❌ **The Problem** / ✅ **Our Value**

Running regular browser use agents as-is has limited viability for repetitive tasks. They're too slow, too expensive, and too unreliable. And forget about authenticated sites: most agents can't handle 2FA at all.

Dari is different. We're purpose-built for production use, combining intelligent caching with automatic 2FA handling so your automations actually run reliably, day after day.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94481&key=user_uploads/870512/3282af1a-0e2b-4e5b-a6ef-24962de4c65e)

**💪 Our 3 Core Strengths**

**1. 🔒 2FA That Actually Works: Automate Authenticated Workflows**

* **Universal 2FA support:** Automatically handles text message codes, TOTP authenticators, and email verification.

**2. ⚡ Intelligent Caching: Fast and Reliable**

* **Run once, cache forever:** After running a workflow with an LLM once, Dari can replay the workflow using deterministic DOM steps
* **Fallback intelligence:** If a site changes, Dari automatically detects it, adapts, then caches the new path
* **Why other agents fail:** Regular browser-use agents call LLMs on every single run. Dari only uses AI when needed.

**3. 🧩 Built for Developers: Real Integration, Not Toys**

* **Chat-to-automation:** Describe your workflow in plain English and get a working automation in seconds.
* **API-first triggers:** Start workflows via POST request, integrate directly into your stack.
* **Webhook & Wait:** Call your backend mid-workflow, run custom code, and continue the automation seamlessly.

**💥 Real Impact**

* A voice AI company automated data entry and form filling tasks, saving 10+ hours per week.

**🧑‍💻🧑‍💻 How we got here**

We’re two Caltech CS grads who have previously worked on software at Amazon and Uber. 

We’ve been building with browser use agents since the initial model releases and were constantly frustrated by how unreliable they were for production use-cases. We built Dari to fix the problems we’ve noticed since the start. 

**🎉 Get Started**

Sign up or schedule a demo at [usedari.com](http://usedari.com) or contact us at [founders@usedari.com](mailto:founders@usedari.com).

launches.tagline: AI that runs your backoffice - so your team can run logistics.
launches.body:
Hi everyone, we’re Niclas and Felix, and we’re launching Lunavo!

**TLDR:**

Lunavo is the AI assistant that automates the backoffice of trucking carriers so teams can focus on customers and growth.

_Launch Video:_

https://youtu.be/fKWHgdt8hv0 

**The problem:**

Trucking carriers coordinate complex operations to transport goods from A to B , but they spend most of their time on repetitive admin work like entering orders, updating portals, and checking systems. Most communication is still handled manually.

This creates two problems. First, teams waste hours on busywork instead of managing operations. Second, the noise makes it nearly impossible to spot issues that need attention until it's too late. A delayed pickup, missing document, or customer escalation only gets noticed when it's already urgent.

The real complexity isn't in data entry. It's in catching and resolving issues early: rerouting around delays, finding backup capacity, flagging exceptions before they cascade. Carriers need visibility and time to handle what matters, not endless manual updates.

We sat with dispatchers managing hundreds of shipments a day and saw their inbox and phone effectively act as their task managers.

·   Many handle between 50 and 100 emails per hour, and most of them are repetitive.

·   Teams constantly pull data from emails, PDFs, and portals into their Transport Management System (TMS).

·   They often jump between ten or more tools that don't communicate properly with each other.

Companies end up paying skilled employees to move data between tools instead of running logistics

**Our solution:**

Lunavo integrates into a carrier's existing systems as an AI teammate. When a new order arrives, it automatically extracts details, updates the TMS, and confirms with the customer. Dispatchers see: "New order from Customer X confirmed and scheduled."

**The system handles routine work while monitoring for exceptions** like delayed pickups, missing documents, or customer escalations, surfacing issues before they become urgent. It understands task dependencies and escalates only what needs human judgment.

Because logistics workflows often depend on implicit knowledge, our system can understand customer workflows and adapt to it. Our agents self-improve through dispatcher feedback, company documentation, and user-defined rules, automatically adapting to each customer's unique requirements without manual reconfiguration.

Lunavo manages to understand incoming documents, extract relevant information, challenges the inputs on plausibility and integrates them into the TMS. In case of anomalies, the system loops in the dispatcher:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95229&key=user_uploads/2331002/607a54fb-83cd-423d-8c36-312523817e4b)

**_Before Lunavo_**_:_ A driver is delayed. The dispatcher has to (1) log into the GPS portal, (2) inform the customer with an update, (3) manually update the TMS, and (4) update the customer's portal for delivery time. This takes up to 15 minutes of work.

**_With Lunavo:_** Lunavo detects the truck's GPS delay. It _automatically_ emails the customer, updates their portal, and sends a single notification to the dispatcher to keep him in the loop: "Driver 5 is delayed 30m. Customer X has been notified. No action needed."

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95229&key=user_uploads/2331002/bdb58f1b-2c10-4e29-b485-d64718f81c6f)

Lunavo helps trucking companies scale operations without scaling headcount.

**About us:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95229&key=user_uploads/2331002/531e2a61-c332-4ee9-ae0a-520a28e47341)

We're Felix and Niclas, founders of Lunavo. Together, we've spent the past years at the intersection of logistics and AI.

·   **Felix** worked with logistics and supply chain companies at McKinsey and later built a robotics logistics company in Germany, spending five years deeply embedded in the industry.

·   **Niclas** studied Computer Science at the Technical University of Munich and the University of Waterloo, focusing on AI security and applied machine learning

**Our ask:**

If you work in logistics or know someone running operations in road transportation, we would love to connect.

You can reach us at felix.loesch@lunavo.ai or visit [www.lunavo.ai](http://www.lunavo.ai).

launches.body:
Hey everyone! This is [Ben](https://www.linkedin.com/in/benjamin--rubin/) and [Yining](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yining-z/) from [Norra](https://www.linkedin.com/company/norra-io/), the AI equipment operations platform for nursing facilities.

TL;DR: Norra uses AI and real-time tracking to give nursing facilities operational intelligence they've never had.

🚨**The problem:**

Nursing facilities are facing an existential crisis. With the aging population, demand is surging but they can't keep up. Medicare cuts coupled with inefficient operations mean that over 50% of facilities lose money and are struggling to keep their doors open, all while facing a massive impending staff shortage.

Facilities run blindly with zero operational intelligence. They’re scrambling to manage equipment lifecycles, discovering things are broken too late (leading to failed audits), and over-purchasing because they don’t know what they have. This operational chaos costs each facility over $100K and 1,000 hours of staff time per year, time that could be spent caring for patients.

💡**The solution:**

<https://youtu.be/dI02IH5izfk>

With custom hardwares, Norra creates a digital twin of their entire facility, giving staff complete visibility into everything happening on the ground. With all of this data, we are able to use AI to transform the operational chaos into proactive decision making. Instead of reacting to equipment going into disrepair or overpurchasing equipment due to lack of visibility, staff now get actionable insights to prevent waste before it happens.

What it actually means: Preventative maintenance reminders and tracking, Intelligent and automated purchasing workflows, Insights to improve utilization and cut costs

**⚡Impact:** \
\
We've cut our first facilities' rental spend by 70% and projected to save them $100K+ this year.

**👥 About Us:**

Ben and Yining met two years ago at NASA building astronaut operation software. They are two roommates turned cofounders passionate about using AI to make a real impact in healthcare. 

Ben has spent 1000+ hours in hospitals and nursing facilities seeing first hand how broken their operations are.\
\
Yining built applied AI solutions at MD Anderson Cancer Center, experiencing its potential to revolutionize healthcare.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
Our mission is personal. Each of us watched someone we love slip through the cracks of today’s healthcare system. Peter’s grandfather suffered three preventable ER readmissions before passing—his ruptured aorta went undetected after missed medications and a complete absence of follow-up care. Lukas’s grandmother, who raised him, deteriorated in assisted living—isolated, depressed, and unrecognizable before passing unexpectedly just days before he arrived. Kazuki’s grandfather battled cancer alone in Japan, cut off from family by COVID-era hospital restrictions—reminding us that healing requires more than medicine.

What we experienced is not rare. It’s the reality for tens of millions of older adults. In ERs, nursing homes, and senior communities where we’ve volunteered, we saw the same  patterns: chronic conditions unmanaged, dangerous falls ignored, weeks without human connection, and emergencies that could have been prevented. Aging has become a quiet crisis—fueled by staff shortages, fragmented systems, lack of technology access, and stigma about growing old. 

We’ve invested 600+ hours on the ground working with older adults to deeply understand their’ needs, motivations, and barriers. TL;DR

Create cinema that feels real. Koyal captures emotional tone from your audio, turning emotion into cinematic scenes with consistent characters and settings. You can storyboard, direct, and edit every scene to perfection.

# **The Problem**

Filmmakers, musicians, and creators spend **weeks to months scripting, shooting, and editing** or pay **$100,000+** to agencies to get something that feels right.\
\
Even with new AI tools, you’re still wrestling with prompting, uncanny performances, and inconsistent characters.

# **The Solution**

Koyal lets you speak your story once, and watch it come to life.\
We capture the **emotional tone** in your voice or script and translate it into expressive, cinematic performances with consistent characters, settings and storylines.

You can **storyboard, reshoot, and refine** each scene naturally, like directing your own crew: no complex prompts, no model wrangling, no editors needed.\
\
Just your voice, your script, and your vision.

# **How Koyal Works**

[Demo Video](https://youtu.be/6Slhq8fbQ1c?si=9OaAU2xVKzhEbre8)

* **Upload your script or record your voiceover**: Koyal understands the emotion, pacing, and intent behind every line.
* **Design your characters**: Create an AI character or safely place yourself in the film using **CHARCHA: our Character Captcha protocol** that ensures your likeness is used **with verified consent.**

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94569&key=user_uploads/2383496/0f411243-c4be-4b15-af57-b5ae3f957e2d)

* **Craft your world:** Create or find real-life locations to shoot your movie in, add assets and choose art styles (animated, realistic, etc.)
* **Auto-generate cinematic scenes**: complete with consistent characters, environments, and shot logic.
* **Storyboard and edit visually**: adjust lighting, camera angle, or emotion directly with simple directions like “make it more hopeful” or “change the setting to night.”
* **Export your finished film**: ready to share across YouTube, socials, or investor decks.

# **In Action**

We’ve battle-tested Koyal across **music, media, and startups**.

* Worked with **Universal Music**, **T-Series**, and major Bollywood studios.
* Created videos for **Grammy and Oscar-winning artists** like [A.R. Rahman](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BeaAHxFl-6A), [Ricky Kej](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xT7NTK_Y_TY), and [Shankar Mahadevan](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZSkpEaud9-o), each crossing **1.5M+ views**.
* Partnered with **22 YC companies** to create their [launch videos](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/y-combinator_brickanta-isthe-construction-estimator-and-activity-7378775629376364544-A2vW?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAABZ8s4EB2S4yNxvn-aoVAyfMlfkG_me_3f8) in days, not weeks.

**Who We Are**

We’re **Mehul and Gauri Agarwal**, a brother-sister team obsessed with reimagining how stories are told. \
\
We are a team from MIT, CMU and Meta with experience building in AI video. Koyal evolved directly from our [research published at Neurips 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.02610).

# **The Future of Filmmaking**

Koyal is inspired by how **Pixar builds stories** : audio first, visuals second.\
We aim to replace the camera with intelligent AI systems that understand how to **translate human intent into cinematic storytelling**.

You no longer need cameras, expensive sets and set pieces, or prompts: just your voice and imagination.

Try it now at[ ](https://koyal.ai)[koyal.ai](https://koyal.ai/)

We can’t wait to see what _you_ create.\
Mehul & Gauri 

\- kookoo

launches.body:
Hello everyone! We’re [Anish](https://x.com/_anishgupta_) and [Marc](https://x.com/marczog), the Co-Founders of PlayVision!\
\
**TL;DR:** PlayVision lets basketball teams automatically analyze their practices and games to get advanced stats on their players, opponents, and college or high school recruits. We use AI and computer vision to get insights based on their tracking data.

https://youtu.be/MZynlUcUdeU

\
**The Problem**:

❌ Coaches spend over **75%** of their week watching film and manually tagging different stats.

❌ College Teams spend **$250K+** on services like HUDL, Synergy, HDI, and other different products just to watch film and scout players.

❌ There are up to **25x** more coaches between teams across Division 1 basketball — most programs lack the man-power to watch the same amount of film and create a comprehensive game-plan.

❌ College athletes are now able to get paid via their Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL). Teams are scrambling trying to figure out how much players are worth.\
\
**Our Solution**:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94935&key=user_uploads/2540850/425a0c3f-1d4d-4e7d-a46e-241f9655aa11)

An interactive platform that lets coaches upload their film and get the insights they want. We track every player, every movement, every decision made on the court. 

With our database, we also feature:

🏀 Our algorithms that rank every player in the country over the last **10** years.

🏀 Custom indexes where teams leverage over **40** metrics to create their own stats to rank players.

🏀 Automated scouting reports that give coaches **10x** the insights on their players and opponents in **10%** of the time.\
\
**Our Story:**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94935&key=user_uploads/2540850/4ec6f501-bfc9-4758-81e5-910ce716dcc0)

\
I, Anish, was a massive sports fan growing up. I couldn’t play college athletics due to an eye surgery, so I joined Cal Athletics as a scout. I saw first-hand how tedious the manual film analysis was, having to stay late in the office with coaches trying to finish the games we set out to do.

The timing couldn't have been better. Marc, fresh from two years of AI and computer vision research at the Mayo Clinic, happened to be in my AI in SportsTech class at Berkeley. I pitched him my problem, and within minutes, we were deep in discussion about how AI and computer vision could crack it.

Leveraging my connections in the college space, we started getting validation from coaches, expressing the same pain points I had. We’ve partnered with teams from the SEC, BIG 10, and BIG EAST conferences, and you could be next!

**Our Ask**:

👉 If you’re interested in getting data on your favorite players, sign up for our player portal on our website: https://withplayvision.ai/ \

Reach us:

name: Minro
long_description:
Minro helps companies stay close to their users as they scale.

Today, most startups have thousands of product events flowing through tools like PostHog, but still have no real understanding of who their users actually are, which users are quietly about to churn, or what outreach actually brings them back. Founders care deeply about their users, but staying close to them becomes operationally impossible very quickly.

Minro plugs directly into a company’s analytics stack and turns product activity into living customer intelligence. We enrich every user with context like their company, role, LinkedIn/GitHub/Twitter, background, and likely use case, currently matching users to the correct online identity with ~80% accuracy starting from just name + email.

We then identify which users are most likely to churn based on behavioral patterns, persona similarity, and historical retention signals, and help founders proactively reach out before those users disappear. Minro drafts highly contextual founder-style outreach, tracks which conversations actually convert into retention, and continuously improves the system over time.

The result is a customer intelligence and retention layer that helps companies understand their users better, build stronger relationships, and reduce churn before it happens.
one_liner: Identify churn risk and stay close to users at scale

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
We’re cousins who’ve been building things together since we were kids. Samika had already founded a company before Iris building scalable enterprise agents. Siddhant has been coding since he was 11 years old and loves building complex systems in the form of consumer applications (12 apps in production, 2500+ active users)

Iris started as something we built for ourselves. We were constantly overwhelmed by scattered calendars, inboxes, and tasks and every “assistant” tool felt either too rigid or too dumb. So we decided to build one that actually understood us, combining the reliability of deterministic systems with the intuition of LLMs.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer:
We started Iris as a side project to fix our own scheduling chaos with a good user experience. The first prototype synced our calendars and emails, and within hours it was already making our days smoother. That’s when we realized how big this could be.

A major inflection point was meeting Adam Cheyer, the founder of Siri. His advice reframed how we thought about the problem - it wasn’t just a UX challenge, it was an engineering problem. We then brought on one of Siri’s founding engineers as a technical advisor, which shaped our architecture around deterministic logic combined with adaptive LLM reasoning.

That shift (from “AI wrapper” to hybrid intelligent system) became the foundation of Iris.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer:
The core problem is cognitive overload because people are drowning in context switching between calendars, emails, and apps just to stay organized. Productivity tools today still expect you to manage them. They don’t understand how you work and make you configure rules and routines that fall apart when real life changes.

We felt that pain deeply ourselves. Both of us are neurodivergent so motivation wasn’t the issue, context was. We didn’t need another to-do list but we needed something that understood our rhythm and made intelligent decisions for us.

Iris exists to eliminate that friction. It learns how you work, automates the repetitive decisions, and keeps you focused on what actually matters. This problem is universal, everyone struggles to stay on top of their time. Solving it unlocks human attention at scale.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
In the future, everyone will have their own Iris: an assistant that actually knows them - how they work, who they meet, where they go and helps them stay a step ahead. When two people both use Iris, their assistants can coordinate directly, handle logistics, and clear out the noise before it reaches them.

At scale, this becomes the foundation for how individuals and teams organize time - from one person’s calendar to entire companies. Iris is how people will work when AI truly understands context.

launches.tagline: Automated penetration testing for modern development teams
launches.body:
👋Hi all, we’re Stephen, Cayden and Jayden from [Veria Labs](https://verialabs.com)!

## TL;DR

* Most companies pentest only 1-2x per year, but high-performing teams deploy multiple times per day 
* We're building AI agents that continuously find vulnerabilities in your application
* **Our ask:** If you're at a fintech, healthcare, or crypto company that wants to be secure while moving fast, let’s talk: <https://verialabs.com/contact>

---

## The Problem

You ship code constantly. You test for security once a year, if at all.

This isn't a startup problem. It's structural. PCI DSS mandates annual pentests. HIPAA requires regular security assessments. Crypto projects get audited before launch. But after that initial test, your codebase evolves, you add features, you refactor, and there's no continuous security validation.

Traditional pentesting is **fundamentally broken** for modern development:

**It's too slow.** Results take weeks to deliver. By the time you get the report, your codebase has changed 50+ times.

**It's too expensive.** $15,000-$30,000+ per engagement. You can't afford to test continuously at these prices, but you also can't afford _not_ to be secure.

**It has terrible coverage.** Pentesters scope to 5-10 application features because that's all they can audit in two weeks. The rest of your codebase gets ignored. Your background jobs, admin panels, internal APIs are all potential attack vectors that never get looked at.

**It's too shallow.** Even within their limited scope, human pentesters are constrained by time. They get 5-10 days, bill $250-300/hour, and move on to the next client. They find the obvious vulnerabilities: SQL injection, XSS, broken auth. But complex, multi-step exploits that require deep exploration of your business logic get missed because there's simply not enough time.

Meanwhile, 1 in 5 companies don't test their software for security vulnerabilities at all.

## Our Solution

We're building AI agents that run continuously on your codebase and send you actionable results every Monday morning.

**Why we're different from traditional pentesting:**

Our agents aren't constrained by human hours or budgets. We can test exhaustively: every code path, every edge case, every possible attack chain. We're not just faster and cheaper. We find more bugs.

**Why we're different from SAST tools (Semgrep, Snyk):**

Static analysis tools flag potential issues but can't exploit them. Our LLM-based agents:

* Actually exploit vulnerabilities to prove they're real (no false positives)
* Understand and adapts to your business logic and data flows
* Learn your codebase architecture and conventions, which means dramatically fewer false positives
* Chain together low-severity findings into high-impact exploits

## About Us

We're members of the [#1 competitive hacking (CTF) team](https://ctf.gg/contests) in the United States.

Between us, we've found critical vulnerabilities in AI tools, operating systems, fintech apps, and billion-dollar crypto exchanges. The future of security testing is automated, and we're building it.

## What We’re Looking For

If you:

* Deploy code daily but test for security sporadically (or never)
* Are spending $30K+ per year on pentests that are outdated within weeks
* Need continuous security without hiring an entire red team
* Want to find complex vulnerabilities before attackers do

Let's talk: <https://verialabs.com/contact>

We're especially interested in working with **fintech, healthcare, and crypto companies** (where the stakes are highest), but if you're facing similar challenges in other industries, we'd love to hear from you too.

launches.body:
Hey everyone, Ritanshu and Abhimanyu here from Questom.

We’re building **AI agents that handle the everyday conversations B2B companies rely on to sell.**\
\
[**Questom: AI Agents for Sales**](https://youtu.be/EkodDghaQ4A)

## **TL;DR**

Most B2B revenue still runs through **phone calls and emails**, not websites.

Teams struggle to:

* answer every inquiry
* follow up consistently
* collect details cleanly
* apply the right catalog + pricing rules
* generate accurate quotes
* and keep customers updated

Questom trains **AI sales agents** that do all of this automatically, using your workflows, your rules, your language, and your systems.

Our agents live directly inside the communication channels B2B teams already use:

**📞 Phone • 📧 Email • 💬 Chat • 📱 SMS**

They handle inbound conversations end-to-end and hand off to humans only when needed.

# **🚨 The Problem**

Across wholesalers, distributors, field-service companies, custom-order shops, foodservice, industrial supply, packaging, labels, and more — the story is the same:

**Revenue depends on conversations.**

Every day teams handle:

• “Can you do this?”

• “How much will it cost?”

• “Can I get it by Friday?”

• “Where’s my order?”

• “Can I change something?”

But these companies run lean.

Sales, operations, and customer service are often the _same people_ juggling:

* quoting
* re-quotes
* customer updates
* scheduling
* inventory/lead-time questions
* supplier coordination
* repeat jobs
* production constraints

When things get busy, response times slip, inboxes pile up, and high-intent buyers quietly move on.

This creates:

* Missed revenue
* Burnt-out teams
* Customers who don’t come back
* An invisible tax on growth

People think “chatbots” solve this, but bots don’t understand:

* catalogs
* pricing rules
* discounts
* exceptions
* minimums
* production timelines

B2B sales is _not_ FAQ automation.

It’s conversational problem-solving.

# **💡 The Solution**

**Questom builds AI sales agents that run your inbound sales process.**

They learn:

* your catalog
* your pricing
* your discounts & exceptions
* your constraints
* your approval flows
* your lead times
* your edge cases
* your CRM/ERP logic

The agent:

* answers instantly
* asks the right questions
* collects order requirements
* applies your pricing logic
* generates quotes and revisions
* manages follow-ups
* sends status updates
* and pushes structured orders into your ERP/CRM

When needed, the agent hand-offs to a human with full context, so nothing gets lost.

### **Operational impact:**

* Faster first responses
* Fewer missed inquiries
* More accurate quoting
* More deals closed
* Less repetitive messaging
* Happier customers
* Less load on your team

# **⚡ Early Results**

Across our pilots with wholesalers, print companies, and multi-location brands:

* Up to **50%** of inbound sales conversations fully automated
* Meaningful **AOV lift** from smart upsells
* Backlogs cleared within days
* More quotes sent → more revenue captured
* Teams finally able to focus on higher-value work

# **👥 About Us**

launches.title: Hopper - Agentic Development Environment for Mainframe/COBOL
launches.tagline: It combines a real TN3270 terminal and an AI agent that can operate across z/OS workflows like COBOL, VSAM, and CICS.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** We’re launching **Hopper**, an agentic development environment for IBM mainframes. It combines a real TN3270 terminal and an AI agent that can operate across z/OS workflows like COBOL, VSAM, and CICS.

Download it here: <https://www.hypercubic.ai/hopper>

Video walkthrough: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q81L5DcfBvE>

You can also request access and immediately get a mainframe user account to try it.

## **Problem**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101267&key=user_uploads/317991/43b88f08-689e-437f-9057-42a45c15eb56)

Mainframes still run a huge amount of critical infrastructure: banking, payments, insurance, airlines, government programs, logistics, and core enterprise operations.

A lot of that software is written in COBOL and runs on IBM z/OS. These systems are reliable, secure, and deeply embedded into business operations, but the development environment looks nothing like modern software development.

Modern AI coding tools assume repos, files, shells, package managers, test runners, and CI pipelines.

Mainframe development is an entirely different computing paradigm.

A simple COBOL change might require finding the right source member, checking copybooks, locating compile JCL, submitting a job, reading JES/SYSPRINT output, interpreting condition codes, patching fixed-width source, and resubmitting.

Much of this work is structured and repetitive, but today it still depends heavily on expert humans who know how to navigate the terminal, interpret output, and follow local conventions.

A chatbot next to a terminal is not enough.

For AI to be useful here, the agent needs to operate inside the mainframe environment itself.

## **Solution**

Today we’re launching **Hopper**, an agentic development environment for mainframes.

Hopper combines three things:

1. A real TN3270 terminal
2. Mainframe-aware panels for datasets, members, jobs, and spool output
3. An AI agent that can operate across z/OS workflows

The agent can navigate ISPF, inspect datasets, write and edit COBOL, generate and modify JCL, submit jobs, parse JES spool output, analyze return codes, query VSAM, interact with CICS, and explain failures.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101267&key=user_uploads/317991/2c056d32-2347-4dd9-9b53-697349527628)


## **Why this matters**

The mainframe is not just a codebase. It is an operating environment with its own workflows, conventions, interfaces, and failure modes.

Most AI coding tools treat legacy systems like static repositories. That misses a huge part of the real work.

In mainframe environments, the important context often lives across terminal screens, datasets, job output, copybooks, CICS regions, VSAM files, scheduler conventions, and decades of operational knowledge.

Hopper’s design principle is simple:

Preserve the fidelity of the mainframe environment, but make it accessible to AI agents.

Once agents can safely operate inside the mainframe, new workflows become possible:

* Faster job debugging
* Automated documentation
* Safer COBOL changes
* Test generation
* Migration planning

We think this is the missing layer between today’s AI coding tools and the mission-critical systems that still run much of the world.

## **Who we are**

We’re Sai and Aayush, former Apple AIML engineers, and we’re building Hypercubic to bring AI-native maintenance and modernization infrastructure to mainframe and COBOL systems.

### **🤝 What we’re looking for**

* **Intros:** Connections to CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, or Heads of Modernization at Fortune 500 companies, particularly in banking, insurance, manufacturing and retail.
* **Enterprises** running COBOL or mainframe workloads exploring modernization or knowledge retention.
* **Systems integrators / consultancies** seeking AI-powered tooling for mainframe understanding and modernization.

launches.title: Hypercubic – AI to maintain and modernize COBOL/Mainframes
launches.tagline: Capture and preserve decades of institutional human expertise from your mainframe systems.
launches.body:
# **TLDR ⚡️**

Hypercubic helps Fortune 500s understand, preserve, and modernize their critical mainframe systems. These are the COBOL systems from the 1960s that still power banking, insurance, retail, airlines, government and more.

# **Asks 🤝**

We’d love intros to:

* CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, or Heads of Modernization at Fortune 500s, especially in banking, insurance, logistics, and airlines.
* Any enterprise running COBOL or mainframe workloads.
* Systems integrators or consultancies that work on mainframe maintenance or modernization.

# **The Problem**

**70% of the Fortune 500 enterprises still run on mainframes and COBOL originally built in the 1960s**. These systems run the global economy, yet they’ve become black boxes. The engineers who built and maintained these systems are retiring and what’s left behind is systems that are opaque, brittle, and nearly impossible to modify without risking production outages.

This institutional knowledge is a ticking time bomb:

* **Vanishing Expertise:** The handful of engineers who understand the nuances of decades-old COBOL, JCL, and CICS systems are retiring or leaving.
* **Failed Modernizations:** Without this deep expertise, modernization projects often fail, costing millions and creating brittle, unmaintainable systems.
* **Inadequate Documentation:** Static, outdated documentation can't explain _why_ a system was built a certain way or how to debug a critical failure at 3 AM.

Current "AI for code" tools analyze repositories, but they can't capture the unwritten rules, historical context, and architectural reasoning that lives only in the minds of the most senior engineers.

**The result: trillion-dollar infrastructure with no surviving map or maintainers.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94926&key=user_uploads/317991/40a1cc5c-9859-4df9-8dc4-50e9c7f9ab8f)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94926&key=user_uploads/317991/0ec58980-1b71-49bd-bdd7-6bd6fa926bc4)

# **Our Solution**

**Hypercubic is building an AI-native maintenance and modernization platform that learns how legacy mainframe systems _actually work_ — and captures the human reasoning behind them.**

We start with:

* **HyperDocs**, which ingests complex COBOL, JCL, and PL/I codebases to generate accurate high-fidelity documentation, architecture diagrams, and dependency graphs — giving teams an instant, living map of their systems.
* **HyperTwin**, which captures the institutional expertise of retiring engineers by observing their workflows, screen interactions, and verbal reasoning. It builds a _digital twin_ of the experts on how they debug, architect, and maintain these systems in practice.

Together, HyperDocs and HyperTwin form an institutional knowledge layer that links _code_, _systems_, and _human reasoning_ — **enabling the next phase: autonomous AI agents that can safely maintain and modernize critical mainframes end-to-end.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94926&key=user_uploads/317991/d9b867b9-cb41-4152-bc37-4dd215405d92)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94926&key=user_uploads/317991/a4cebb8f-05e5-44b6-9e1b-9c932fdc7dbb)

# **Why now?**

**We’re at the tipping point of one of the largest knowledge transitions in human history.**

For decades, the systems that run our banks, airlines, and governments have quietly relied on a generation of engineers whose expertise lives only in their minds — and that generation is disappearing (baby boomer generation).

As the “silver tsunami” accelerates, **we’re watching trillions of dollars of institutional memory vanish line by line.** Every retirement is a lost encyclopedia. Every undocumented function is a forgotten decision that once held a company together.

At the same time, AI has finally evolved from pattern-matching to _reasoning_, giving us the tools to preserve and replicate that expertise before it’s gone.

**For the first time, we can capture how systems think, not just how they run turning decades of fragile human memory into living, searchable intelligence.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94926&key=user_uploads/317991/fd8874f2-b27c-4a7e-a8b9-a64325efe3d3)

📩 You can reach us at [**team@hypercubic.ai**](mailto:team@hypercubic.ai) or learn more at [**www.hypercubic.ai**](http://www.hypercubic.ai)

name: Nessie
long_description:
Knowledge work is being restructured by AI. Strategy happens in Claude. Research happens in ChatGPT. Building happens in Claude Code and Codex. Meetings get recorded, notes get written, agents run for hours and leave behind traces nobody reads. The people defining the next decade of work are already thinking with AI every day. But none of that thinking compounds. Every session starts from zero. The reasoning behind decisions, the context behind strategies, the evolution of ideas across hundreds of conversations - all of it evaporates.

Nessie is the infrastructure that makes it permanent. We auto-sync AI conversations and agent traces across every major provider - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, and more - alongside meetings, notes, and email from tools like Granola, Read AI, Plaud, and Obsidian. Everything a team produces with AI flows into one place and compounds over time.

Nessie turns that raw, heterogeneous data into an ontology: the live state of a company. Not a static schema but a continuously updated record of what the company knows, what it has decided, who owns what, and how its thinking has evolved, kept current as new work flows in. It is queryable from any agent through our CLI, MCP connector, and plugins, shareable across a team with real permissions, and deployable on-prem for organizations that need it.

Then the loop closes. Once a company’s state is legible to its agents, every agent run becomes training signal: which skills worked, which failed, which workflows keep repeating. Nessie feeds that signal back as reviewable improvements to the skills, prompts, and processes the team runs on. This is what makes a company recursive: its agents get better from its own history, the people working with them get better too, and the compounding never stops.

Where we are going: the AI-native organization runs thousands of agents that are powerful but amnesiac. Nessie is the layer that gives them, and the humans steering them, a shared memory. Science has journals, law has case law, software has git; AI-native knowledge work has had nothing. We are building it.

Founded by two Yale CS grads and former Amazon engineers, now a team of three in San Francisco. Backed by BoxGroup, Pioneer Fund, Y Combinator, Precursor, and more.

launches.tagline: Turn your AI chats into searchable memory
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95270&key=user_uploads/854295/e88fb9f4-8055-4721-94d1-6959e0d83509)

Hey everyone! We're [Anna](https://www.linkedin.com/in/anna-zhang-y/) and [Tiger](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tiger-wang-6a9b06189/) – co-founders of [Nessie](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/nessie).

**TLDR**: Nessie turns your scattered AI conversations into a personal knowledge base where you can search, ask questions, and surface new insights.

Many of us now think through AI conversations. Our most creative moments and deepest explorations happen in conversations with AI. Nessie is Perplexity for your mind, giving every AI conversation a permanent memory.

# **The Problem**

Your best ideas are scattered.

Brilliant insights are buried in endless AI chat histories, impossible to find or build upon. Trying to connect an idea from last Tuesday’s chat with a note from today is a nightmare of copying, pasting, and losing context.

Your best ideas deserve to compound.

# **The Solution: A Home for Your Ideas**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FPSfW_0jFr4

Nessie gives your ideas a home—a single, fluid space where your notes and AI conversations live together. It’s a thinking partner that effortlessly captures your insights, building a single, perfect memory of your ideas.

This lets you:

1. **Build your personal knowledge base, effortlessly**.

   Import your entire ChatGPT history, or capture individual conversations that you don’t want to lose. Nessie automatically distills your conversations into structured notes, organized around topics you care about. Your existing ideas become a structured, searchable knowledge base without you lifting a finger.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95270&key=user_uploads/2910312/ac6fef3a-848f-45c9-8b46-667661498cfd)

2. **Instantly find any idea**.

   Search across your entire knowledge base and unearth your most brilliant ideas in seconds. Never lose a thought to a messy chat history again.
3. **Compound your best thinking**.

   Your knowledge base becomes a thinking partner. You can chat with a specific concept, a folder of notes, or your entire knowledge base to connect ideas and create new insights.
4. **Own your mind**.

   We believe agency over your own thinking is critical, especially in the age of AI. Nessie gives you transparent control over your memory. Your knowledge is built from visible, editable notes that you can shape and delete at will. Everything is stored locally and privately on your device—no one can see it but you.

# **Who This Is For**

Nessie is built for AI-native thinkers: the researchers, founders, VCs, and writers who are already using AI as a partner to develop and challenge their ideas. If you live in ChatGPT and feel its limitations every day, we built Nessie for you.

# **Our Vision**

We are building your personal context layer for the AI age. Our vision is a future where your thinking compounds effortlessly, where no idea is ever lost, and your own knowledge becomes your most powerful tool.

# **About Us**

We built Nessie for ourselves.

We met at Yale and bonded over our shared obsession with using AI to push the limits of our own thinking. We quickly hit a wall. Anna had several Gemini chats that crossed the 1M token context window—a massive limit for any major model today. The brilliant insights from those conversations are now effectively lost.

We felt constrained by tools that weren't built for the way we think, so we built the solution we needed.

We use Nessie every single day.

# **Our Ask**

1. **Try Nessie and build your AI second brain.** We are obsessed with feedback from fellow AI power users and would be honored to hear your honest thoughts.
2. **Follow our journey.** We'll be sharing updates, behind-the-scenes, and our learnings as we build in public.
   * [**X/Twitter**](https://x.com/NessieLabs)
   * [**LinkedIn**](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nessie-labs)
   * [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/6DkXCpVu6K)
3. **Share with a friend.** If you know another founder, researcher, or writer who lives in their AI chats and is constantly losing great ideas, we'd love for you to share Nessie with them.

**Download the Nessie Mac app at[ https://nessielabs.com/](https://nessielabs.com/)**

**Contact us at [founders@nessielabs.com](https://mailto:founders@nessielabs.com)**

launches.title: Wardstone: Satellites for Missile Defense
launches.tagline: Introducing New Space Defense Capabilities for America's Golden Dome
launches.body:
# **Introduction**

Hi YC,\
\
We are [Tobias ](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tobifischer/)and [Sebastian](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sebafischer/). Cofounders (and brothers!) of [Wardstone](https://www.wardstone.space/).\
\
**TL;DR:** Wardstone builds satellites for missile defense. We are pursuing an emerging \~$40B/year space defense market as part of America’s Golden Dome initiative. Tobias studied Mechanical Engineering at Cornell and worked at Astranis. Sebastian studied Aerospace Engineering at MIT and worked at NASA, Lockheed Martin, Amazon, and Cruise. We built and demoed a live ground-based missile intercept during YC.

# **Launch Video**

Checkout the automated missile defense system we built during YC:

https://youtu.be/jXABTM9GZ6s

# **About Wardstone**

Wardstone builds space-based interceptors: satellites with interceptors designed to kinetically destroy missiles. New space threats, specifically hypersonic missiles, are emerging as existential threats to the United States. Our current missile defense systems were not designed for this new offensive technology. The United States’ Congress has allocated \~$25B towards developing new on-orbit hypersonic missile defensive missile capabilities over the next 3 years. Follow on build out of this on-orbit defensive layer coined the _Golden Dome_ has been estimated by congress to cost up to $831B over the next 20 years.\
\
At Wardstone, we believe that we can build defensive missile capabilities for a fraction of the cost of the offensive hypersonic weapons themselves, and orders of magnitude cheaper than the defensive concepts being proposed/explored by the major defense primes. We will do this with our first product, Hailstorm, that deploys high speed clouds of buckshot to kinetically destroy hypersonic missiles.

Our integrated interceptor-satellite constellation provides global intercept capabilities from space for various missile types beyond hypersonics. \
\
The success of Wardstone and the full deployment of the Golden Dome will place the United States in an incredibly strong geopolitical position.

The full Wardstone constellation with the space based intercept capability in action will look like this:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95440&key=user_uploads/2077453/f2a877a7-c23c-438d-8714-5a854930bba2)

# **Our Progress During YC**

During YC we had 2 main objectives: 1) build our first missile intercept demo and 2) establish relationships with our main customer: the US Space Force.\
\
**The Intercept Demo**\
We built a fully automated missile tracking and intercept system that uses infrared computer vision for predicting the future missile position and a high pressure air cannon to deploy an interceptor to destroy a 150+ mph missile. Our system provided repeatable behavior, could adapt to different missile speeds, and destroyed a total of 3 missiles. Checkout he video above for the entire story and insights into our system. Highlights below:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95440&key=user_uploads/2077453/c1d9b5df-8297-4a8a-aec8-a8529cb805e8)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95440&key=user_uploads/2077453/4ea3e37d-2172-4627-bd54-67a1f2374fe3)

**Space Force and Other Department of War Relationships**\
We built relationships and engaged with multiple agencies inside the military including: Air Force Research Labs, AFWERX, Space Systems Command Commercialization Office, Space Safari, and the Navy’s Joint Special Operations Command. We are receiving letters of support for an Air Force $3MM Space Based Interceptor SBIR grant and are receiving inbound requests for additional use cases of our technology (Ground to Air, Space to Ground).\
\
We have also engaged with five satellite bus and sounding rocket providers to integrate our Space Based Interceptors for our Series A demo milestone.\
\
If Space Defense Technology resonates with you, please reach out: [founders@wardstone.space](mailto:founders@wardstone.space).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95440&key=user_uploads/2077453/129abf15-7925-4374-9279-d48e58da1fa2)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W-VDeXPeNCA

**TLDR**

AtlasGrid automatically builds a visual graph of your mobile app UI and displays analytics directly on your screens. Additionally, our fleet of AI-powered agents will continuously analyze thousands of mobile apps, gathering design insights and identifying growth opportunities and actionable product improvements.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95857&key=user_uploads/32432/63720cfd-c630-4559-a683-55aa9a607eeb)

**The Problem**

Product teams today operate in an increasingly fragmented environment. As organizations scale, documentation becomes scattered across PRDs, design files, JIRA tickets, and BI dashboards.

The lack of an up-to-date data dictionary causes analysts to have to track down subject-matter experts or ask engineers to audit the code to confirm the implementation of events. Designers creating new experiment variants find it hard to understand what users do on their existing screens before changing them (_“I wish Figma had a **data mode**”_). There’s often no single, authoritative ‘**source of truth**’ file for the interface design that can be referenced to understand what a user _actually_ sees, and in some cases, there is no Figma file at all (as designers adopt tools like Cursor to prototype). Oftentimes, product personnel resort to manually annotating Figma files with analytics found in their BI tools, or manually screenshotting parts of their own app.

These obstacles make it difficult to form a coherent, end-to-end understanding of a complex app. As a result, teams operate with partial or conflicting information, leading to missed growth opportunities.

**Introducing AtlasGrid, an easy way to see your data in context**

AtlasGrid uses an AI agent to go through your iOS and Android app, building a graph of the app architecture. It captures your analytics events, and builds a searchable graph of your app. You can easily find app screens, flows, events and even see funnel + CTA conversion rates directly on your UI. This makes it easy to get answers to questions like _“which upsells drive most of my trials”_ or _“where am I losing most of my users in onboarding”_. By tracking changes across every version of your app, every feature flag, we will become a source of truth for your product development cycle.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95857&key=user_uploads/32432/ae6d9a35-971a-41d8-b6a3-dde2df305631)

**Our Vision**

AtlasGrid is building towards a future in which generative design is commoditized, and the primary differentiator for teams will be performance. How quickly they can identify opportunities, ship improvements, and measure results. Our platform will integrate directly with AI code-generation tools, enabling developers to rapidly launch design variations suggested by “the grid,” dynamically reconfiguring their app for growth.

We believe the future of product development is self-improving applications, as more stages of today’s iteration process become automated. AtlasGrid will accelerate one of the most costly and time-consuming parts of that lifecycle.

**Our founding team**

[**Oleg Kostour**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/olegkostour/) is a 2nd time YC founder and Waterloo alum. He founded Pair (YC W12), a messaging app that received 10M installs and reached the top charts in the iOS social networking category. launches.title: hillclimb - Training data derived from human superintelligence
launches.tagline: Building the human superintelligence community to advance AI
launches.body:
Hello! We’re Jun Park and Ibrakhim Ustelbay, founders of[ hillclimb](https://www.hillclimb.ing).

\_TLDR: To close the gap between today and the arrival of artificial superintelligence, we’re building a community of the world’s brightest minds to create the next generation of training data. Starting with math, we’ve formed the world’s densest cluster of IMO medalists, lean experts, and other math talent to design **RL environments** for frontier labs.\_\
\
[Launch Video](https://youtu.be/30y3-SbRfZM)

# The Problem - Data is accelerating on every axis

**3 years ago,** we were impressed that ChatGPT could get good SAT scores. Today, GPT-5 and other frontier models assist meaningfully in coding, research, and tool use. Within two years, AI systems will autonomously [extend the frontier of science](https://x.com/SebastienBubeck/status/1958198661139009862?s=20).

**Behind every leap in capability is a leap in the sophistication of data:**

* From simple supervised fine-tuning → to richly structured RL environments → to world models and beyond
* From mass labor → to curated, deeply intellectual data generation
* From “labeling tasks” → to capturing the reasoning processes of domain experts

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95533&key=user_uploads/1934623/128c37ee-f8e8-411b-9826-4b1b4492a9e2)

_If AI reflects the intelligence of the people who shape its training data, the next era of progress requires the smartest humans on the planet._

# The Solution - The world’s first _human superintelligence_ community

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95533&key=user_uploads/1934623/1e971272-cd2e-46d9-9814-f81268047155)

**In our first 2 months, we’ve:**

* Built the densest cluster of elite math talent in the industry (IMO medalists, [Putnam Top 50](https://maa.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/2024-William-Lowell-Putnam-Competition-Announcement-of-Winners.pdf), Lean formalization experts, etc.)
* Created _training data_ pipelines that faithfully capture their problem-solving intelligence
* Partnered with [Nous Research](https://nousresearch.com) to help train a model that’s SOTA for math competitions.

**We recruit top talent with a 85% winrate** against incumbents because we treat them as partners, not gig workers. For our work with Nous, we’ve negotiated co-authorship for our mathematicians because the data they produce has become a critical component of AI research.

**Researchers love working with us** because we drop them in our community, allowing the iteration loop to become radically tighter. Instead of waiting for dataset revisions, they collaborate directly with world-class minds and see improvements in minutes, not months.

# Our Story  **🎮 → 👨‍💻 → ⛰️**

It was only two years ago that we retired from competing professionally in esports. We taught ourselves to code and within a year, I became a research engineer at **DeepMind**, and Ibrakhim founded **Headstarter**, the first AI interviewer, scaling it to 100k+ users.

In the business of connecting the world’s smartest people to frontier labs, I understand the AI researcher’s perspective on what makes good training data, and Ibrakhim understands how to properly vet talent.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95533&key=user_uploads/1934623/08897fc4-b9c0-4dfd-913f-61f4bebd1998)

# Our Ask

If you work at a frontier lab and need data (or know anyone who does), please reach out! Email us at [founders@hillclimb.com](mailto:founders@hillclimb.com).

Also, check out our site at [hillclimb.com](https://www.hillclimb.com/). Thanks for the support!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95533&key=user_uploads/1934623/797938d1-6d99-44f5-ad7d-1d302f0193fe)

name: Flick
long_description:
Flick is an AI filmmaking software that lets people create Hollywood-level short films completely using AI end-to-end.

There are many AI tools that can give you 8-second casual clips to post on social media, but when it comes to creating truly high-quality films with coherent storylines, consistent characters, and cinematic aesthetics, they don’t come close due to their lack of flexibility, creative control, and fragmented creative flow.

Founded by an award-winning filmmaker and a founding engineer at Instagram, Flick defines an interface specifically designed for native AI filmmaking that feels natural and enables end-to-end creative flows. Think of Flick as Figma for AI filmmaking.

There are 4 complete AI short films created using Flick that got 20+ awards in international film festivals already and our early creator residency community are generating several AI short films every week.

We are also building a community where we produce our own AI films as well as collaborating with other well-known filmmakers to share their “behind-the-scenes” workflows as resuable templates to inspire users in our community. We not only build product, we also build world-class content.

The whole film industry will be revolutionized by AI and our goal is to be “the product” that defines this category.

Think of it as a new kind of studio + distribution platform for AI-native storytelling: filmmakers use Flick to create cinematic films from idea to final cut, and Flick TV becomes the place where audiences can watch original AI films, series, and creator-led experiments.

Our belief is that AI filmmaking needs more than generation tools. It needs original IP, recurring series, creative direction, production workflows, and a place for audiences to discover the best work.

Flick is building both sides:

\- AI filmmaking platform for creators: go from idea → script → storyboard → shots → edit → finished film in one workspace, with more creative control across characters, styles, scenes, and production workflows.

\- Flick TV, the home for original AI films and series

Try it now: [flick.art](http://flick.art)

launches.title: Flick = Figma + Cursor for AI Filmmaking 🎬
launches.tagline: AI Filmmaking tool for anyone who cares about aesthetics, control, and flexibility
launches.body:
👉 **Other AI tools generate clips** — **Flick lets you direct Films**

👇 **All launch video content made with Flick** by ourselves | 🔊+🎧 recommended

https://youtu.be/daVI0yscN94?si=iEhip6dPkn8E4rwu

👉 Make your first film: [flick.art](https://flick.art/?invite_code=YCLAUNCH) with code: YCLAUNCH

### **Problem**

Many AI tools can give you 8-second casual clips to post on social media, but when it comes to making high-quality films, they don’t come close due to their lack of flexibility, creative control, and fragmented creative flow.

Creators think very differently from consumers. Creators think in a non-linear way — moving back and forth freely to iterate, making decisions at every step. To direct a film, creators need not just visual and character consistency, but also character movement, shot angles, camera language, and emotional arc.

### **Solution**

Flick puts creative power back in the hands of filmmakers:

1. **Infinite Canvas + Chat**

   An infinite canvas where users upload or generate text, images, and video as connected nodes. We integrate multiple models, but instead of prompt-to-video, we let filmmakers think in terms of scripts, characters, and scenes and give them a natural “chat to create on canvas” experience.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95208&key=user_uploads/2980671/b8812b5c-bb57-4071-9c06-8fe98632f7d0)

2. **Editing while creating**

   Creators like to go back and forth when making shots, so we built editing tools directly into the canvas. So, they can define exactly what kind of shot they want to add or delete to ensure a stronger narrative.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95208&key=user_uploads/2980671/03442527-7251-4885-9368-05ebffdb3191)

3. **Studio + Perplexity for film scenes**

   No one creates from nothing, we’ve needed inspiration since the beginning of humanity. That’s why we’re building [Studio](https://flick.art/studio/experiments-too-boring?from=home), where we produce our own [AI films](https://flick.art/studio/short-films-a-letter-in-early-fall?from=home) and collaborate with leading filmmakers to share their behind-the-scenes workflows as reusable canvases and templates for our community members.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95208&key=user_uploads/2980671/9c2e48c5-fdcc-4228-9782-250c0b8325d6)

   And integrated Perplexity for film search, allowing users to find classic film shots as references.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95208&key=user_uploads/2980671/508c6b70-0b8d-4c27-8f40-74481ffde11f)


### **Connect Hollywood？**

[**John Rosenberg**](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0742239/) is a Hollywood filmmaker, producer, and production executive with over 30 years experience. He has worked at studios including 20th Century Fox, Orion, and New Line. His films have premiered at Sundance.

John also is a professor at [USC’s School of Cinematic Arts](https://cinema.usc.edu/directories/profile.cfm?id=33682) and a member of ACE (American Cinema Editors). His editing books, published by Routledge / Focal Press, are widely used by film students around the world.

John joins Flick as our advisor to connect Hollywood filmmaking craft with the next generation of AI storytellers.

### **Now**

👉 Make your first film: [flick.art](https://flick.art/?invite_code=YCLAUNCH) with code: YCLAUNCH

[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/flickart) | [X](https://x.com/flickart_ai) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/SPYgXej78k) | [Instagram](https://instagram.com/flickart_ai) | [TikTok](https://tiktok.com/@flick_art)

### **About Us**

[**Ray**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ruiwang3/) was a founding engineer at Instagram AI team, who helped build the first version of Instagram Stories, launched it and helped grow it from 0 to 400M DAU in 2018. As main contributor, wrote almost all the backend code in the first year. Have built multiple profitable AI products in the past venture.

[**Zoey**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/z0ey/) has been a filmmaker since 2013, graduated from Brown and RISD. She is an award-winning filmmaker and product designer. Previously her creations include commercials for Mercedes-Benz, viral short films with millions of views, an award-winning documentary, and collaborations with leading film talents such as cinematographer Thierry Arbogast (_Léon_). Her AI filmmaking research was published at [SIGGRAPH 2025](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3721250.3742968).

Flick was emerged from the creation of Zoey’s first AI film that got best visual award at [MIT film festival](https://mitaifilmhack.com/winners/). Since then, there are 4 complete AI short films created using Flick that got 20+ awards at international film festivals and our early creator residency are generating several AI short films every week.

---

### **Mission**

The next generation of creators won’t think about “prompting models” at all, they’ll just direct, compose, and feel, and the tools will disappear into their creative flow. That’s the future we’re building toward. And that’s why we exist.

### **Ask**

If you know film studios or creators interested in AI filmmaking, reach out to us: [founders@flick.art](mailto:founders@flick.art) ✌️🍊

launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We’re [Evan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/evanameyer/) and [Jeet](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeetchugh/) – co-founders of [Mod AI](https://usemod.ai).

# **TL;DR**

**Mod AI automates the manual work of processing invoices for growing enterprises.** We’ve already helped accounting teams of 1-20+ streamline their invoice processing by 83%.

**_Ask:_** Can you introduce us to CFOs, controllers, Accounting Directors, or Accounts Payable managers of mid to large companies that could benefit from streamlining their accounting processes with AI? Contact us at [evan@mod-ai.org](mailto:evan@mod-ai.org)

https://youtu.be/XaT6mEQnWmE

# ❌ The Problem

Most growing enterprises still process invoices manually—hiring AP clerks to comb through inboxes, type up documents, and chase approvals. As volume grows, they scramble to add more headcount or outsource to expensive temps.

This creates three major pains:

1. **Cash flow blindness** – No visibility until month-end close
2. **Unscalable manual work** – More invoices means more clerks (highest-turnover role in finance)
3. **Vendor relationship damage** – Late payments and errors erode trust

We talked to 23 CFOs last month—nearly all said their AP process couldn't scale.

# 👷 Our Solution

Mod AI deploys AI agents that handle your accounts payable process end-to-end—from the moment an invoice arrives to the moment it's paid and synced to your books. Companies simply connect their systems and instantly get:

* **Complete invoice capture** 📥**:** Auto-pull from email, supplier portals, EDI, physical mail
* **Intelligent processing** 🧠**:** 97%+ accurate GL coding, 2-way/3-way matching, fraud detection
* **Seamless approval & payment** ✅**:** Custom workflows, one-click approvals, direct sync to accounting software

**Result:** Real-time spend visibility, 10x invoice volume without hiring, and stronger vendor relationships.

# 🙏 Our Ask

If you answer "yes" to any of these, we'd love your help:

* **Do you know any mid-market CFOs, Controllers, or VP Finance leaders** whose AP teams are drowning in manual invoice work? Or are you one yourself? We'd love to show you a demo and discuss how Mod AI can help you scale without adding headcount.
